# Blueshield Officer
1. The Blueshield Officer (BSO) reports directly to the NanoTrasen Representative.
2. The Blueshield Officer is responsible for protecting and defending NanoTrasen Personnel at all times. The defense of station Command is the responsibility of the Security Department and Head of Security.
2.1 The only exception to rule 2 is if the station alert level is Gamma or higher, in which case the Blueshield Officer may assist Security in defending the station. The Blueshield Officer is still expected to prioritize the protection of their charges in the event of a direct threat to their safety, even if it means leaving the station unprotected.
3. The Blueshield Officer may ignore Corporate Law only when performing actions to protect their charges from an [bold]active threat,[/bold] not a potential one.
4. The Blueshield Officer may not take armory weapons from the armory without a permit. Armory permits may only be issued on [color=#0000ff]Code Blue[/color] or higher.
5. The Blueshield Officer is not restricted in the weapons they may carry, so long as armory weapons stay with the Warden's issued permit. However, their weapons should not be visible and must be holstered or placed in a bag or pocket on any alert level below [color=#ff0000]Code Red[/color].
6. The Blueshield Officer should focus on protecting their charges, and [bold]should not be pursuing[/bold] potential threats to the detriment of their charges.
7. The Blueshield Officer cannot interfere with the lawful arrest of a member of Command.
